outcome: Fecal microbiota composition (maternal and newborn meconium)
cohort: The study included 17 pregnant Mexican women (8 with GDM and 9 controls) and 16 of their newborns (8 from GDM mothers and 8 from control mothers).
finding: GDM is associated with specific alterations in the fecal microbiota of women in the third trimester and modifications in the meconium microbiota of their newborns, with some taxa correlating with maternal blood glucose levels.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed between GDM and control groups in the relative abundance of maternal fecal microbiota collected during cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Third trimester of gestation (maternal samples), during cesarean section (maternal samples), and immediately after birth (newborn meconium samples)
